subject: Throughput collapse & elevated 5xx after v3.1 + q8 deploy — BrightPath urgent
messages:

Cc: procure@brightpathhealth.com
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: URGENT: Throughput collapse + 5xx after modelpack v3.1 q8 deploy

Hi team,

We pushed the modelpack v3.1 + q8 quant profile to production this morning per the rollout window and immediately started seeing a severe regression. Quick summary of the impact:

- P95 latency jumped from ~120ms to ~420ms over the last 30m.
- Throughput is down ~60% vs yesterday baseline (same traffic).
- 5xx rate climbed to ~3.7% (was ~0.02% prior to deploy).

This is customer-facing traffic for our triage microservice (non-batch paths) and is currently affecting core flows. We attached logs and a Grafana screenshot.

We need an immediate plan: rollback or an emergency mitigation. We are invoking our incident SLO and need executive visibility — our Head of Ops and Procurement are looped. Please confirm a time for a call in the next 20 minutes and whether Redwood can route us back to the prior model/profile while you investigate.

Janet Liu
VP, Engineering Ops
BrightPath Health
Attachments: brightpath-error-log-0606.json, grafana-p95-spike-0606.png

- Prepare an immediate rollback to the v3.0 + q4 profile (we can rollback within ~8-12 minutes once you give approval).
- Run a short mitigation: cap concurrency and reduce max batch size for your routes.

Forwarding BrightPath's message — impact looks severe (p95 x3.5, throughput -60%, 5xx ~3.7%). Please triage immediately.

- Karthik: quick hypothesis on q8 quant interaction with v3.1 (memory, decode path overhead).
- Grace/Olga: leadership / CS posture and exec sync; BrightPath has procurement on the thread.

I’m authorizing a rollback if your quick checks indicate the q8 profile is the root cause. We need a recommended mitigation and an internal exec note within 30m.

— Ben
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: janet.liu@brightpathhealth.com
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 09:28:14 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: URGENT: Throughput collapse + 5xx after modelpack v3.1 q8 deploy

Ben / team — quick notes from an initial triage (logs attached in runbook):

- Telemetry shows increased per-token CPU time on the decode kernels when q8 is used with v3.1; latency grows superlinearly at higher sequence lengths.
- Several inference hosts show KV cache fragmentation and repeated cache compaction events that coincide with spikes in context-switching and GC in the hosting runtime. That correlates with the 5xx bursts (OOM/timeout retries causing 502/504).
- The q8 profile on v3.1 changes certain fused kernels and increases memory pressure on our older instance types — we rolled that configuration into a subset of traffic this morning.

Immediate mitigations I propose:
1) Route BrightPath traffic to v3.0 with q4 profile (previous known-good) — low risk, fastest.
2) If rollback not approved: reduce max_concurrency for their routes to 4 and hard-cap batch_size to 2.
3) After stabilization, run a controlled A/B with synthetic load to reproduce and surface regression metrics.

I’ll attach a short runbook (runbook-rollback-qprofiles.pdf) and a quick command set to do the profile swap. If Ben authorizes, infra can execute step 1 in ~8–12m.

— Karthik Iyer
Senior Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
